aiDescription: Adds a sidebar plugin that helps locate threat fleets. It becomes active only after finding the Onslaught Mk1 or obtaining a specific memory flag, and tracks the single closest threat fleet in the current system. The plugin emits beeps when threats are present, increasing in frequency as the player approaches the tracked fleet.
